cause: The executed train function called inputs(cfg, arm) without passing device; inputs defaults to CPU.
discovered_during: G Adam trajectory, before reference scoring
remote_evidence: CUDA availability verified; nvidia-smi during G Adam 500 reported 0 percent utilization and 4 MiB; source default establishes tensor placement.
decision: Preserve all updates and complete G, N and S on the same CPU device on the authorized cloud instance. Do not restart, alter weights, sampling, optimizer, precision or budget. Report measured CPU training costs only.
limitations: No GPU training speed or universal efficiency claim; sequential three-arm schedule and electrical work counts remain reportable. Future GPU execution requires its own authorization and cannot replace these observed endpoints.
